title: Swiping the same faces
old_caption: Taurus on the subway, swiping the same three profiles on a loop. NEXT STOP: SAME FACES. But he's familiar. The conductor star would like a word. Which sign gets stuck in a loop?

title: Everyone's from somewhere
old_caption: In Toronto everyone's from somewhere, so the stars tried to say hi back in every language, spinning, out of breath. Then: 'we're stars, we're from everywhere.' How do you say hello?

title: All 12 signs in 60 seconds
old_caption: Twelve signs, sixty seconds. Aries goes first, Leo refuses to leave the spotlight, Sag bolts mid-sentence, and Pisces cries lovingly at the end of the line. Tag your sign in the comments.

title: Paying to be seen?
old_caption: Someone put a paywall on the sky. One coin, one tiny twinkle. Second coin, smaller twinkle. Third coin, spat back out. Babe, they're stars. So the gold star broke the padlock.

title: Your Venus sign = how you love
old_caption: Fire Venus rented a blimp. Earth Venus bakes you bread every week. Air Venus wants to hear everything, then more. Water Venus is crying, it's fine. And Venus can't get far from the Sun. Which Venus are you?

title: Launch city #2 is up to you
old_caption: The Libra star can't pick the next city, obviously, so it handed the vote to you. Every vote becomes a brand-new baby star with eyes. Where should the stars go next?

title: Align starts in Houston
old_caption: The Houston star woke up first and tried to wake ten sleepy cities. Hello? Anyone up? Crickets. Turns out every vote wakes one a little. Which city should light up next?

title: Houston got the stars first
old_caption: The gold star landed on top of Houston, got hit with the humidity, and now can't choose between ten cities. Its suitcase tag just says TO: question mark. Which city should be next?

title: Left on read for two days
old_caption:
Two days of silence after "see you friday?" is a lot to sit with.
Ask once, kindly, and give them room to answer. Three question marks can wait.

title: "It's fine." (it is not fine)
old_caption:
"It's fine" usually means it isn't, and the other person can't read your mind.
Say the real feeling and ask for a new night. Wanting to see someone is not needy.
